name: X/Twitter Real-Time Search Intelligence API
description: Search X/Twitter tweets by keyword/hashtag, get trending topics by country, extract user profiles and engagement metrics, and monitor conversation threads — all without X's $42,000/year official API.
longDescription: Real-time X/Twitter intelligence pipeline: search tweets, get trending topics, extract user profiles, fetch user tweets, and monitor conversation threads through mobile proxies. Provides the same data as X's Basic tier ($100/month) and Pro tier ($5,000/month) at x402 micropayment prices. Essential for social listening, brand monitoring, competitive intelligence, and market research.
whyMobileProxy: X.com rolls out anti-scraping changes every 2-4 weeks. Guest tokens expire, rate limits shift constantly. Mobile carrier IPs are critical because X's mobile app generates the majority of traffic, so mobile IPs face significantly less scrutiny. X's detection system profiles request patterns by IP type — mobile IPs get the most generous rate limits (5-10x more than datacenter/residential).

search.results: TweetResult[] — id, author{handle,name,followers,verified}, text, created_at, likes, retweets, replies, views, url

user.profile: XUserProfile — handle, name, bio, location, followers, following, tweets_count, verified, avatar_url, banner_url, joined_date, url

userTweets.tweets: Tweet[] — id, text, created_at, likes, retweets, replies, views, url

thread.thread: ThreadTweet[] — id, author{handle,name}, text, created_at, likes, retweets, replies, is_reply, parent_id, url

vs.name: X/Twitter API Basic
vs.limitation: 10k reads/month, no full-archive search, limited filtering

competitive.ourAdvantage: Pay-per-request at $0.005-0.02/call with no monthly commitment. Real-time search, trending, user profiles, and thread extraction via mobile proxies. Zod v4 validated inputs for AI agent compatibility.

required.name: WALLET_ADDRESS
required.description: Solana wallet address for x402 payment receipt

optional.name: PROXY_HOST
optional.description: Mobile proxy host for X profile scraping. Not required for search (uses SearXNG/OpenSERP).

optional.name: SEARXNG_BASE
optional.description: Self-hosted SearXNG instance URL for search aggregation. Defaults to built-in endpoint.

limitations: Search results depend on search engine indexing — not all tweets are indexed
Engagement metrics (likes, retweets, views) are best-effort from meta tags
User profile scraping via proxy may be blocked by X anti-scraping measures
Rate limited to 20 proxy requests/minute per client IP
Thread extraction relies on search engine results — long threads may be incomplete

/api/x/search.description: Search X/Twitter tweets by keyword/hashtag with sort options

/api/x/user/:handle.description: Get X/Twitter user profile by handle
